plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Your Obsidian vault (S3 bucket or local folder) as Claude's persistent memory: indexed search, session-start context, a repo log with commit shas, and lint. Bundles the notes-vault-mcp server, two hooks and a workflow skill.

plugins.name: herdr-review
plugins.description: Review a repo's changes in a herdr split next to Claude: filterable file list, unified diffs in nvim, file:line comments typed into Claude's input box, read marks that hold until a file changes. Plus tig in a split for history.
